title: RFL Skill ISA composition file
description: Validates a Skill ISA composition file (the JSON / YAML form an author writes; reference instance examples/01-cable-insertion/skill.yaml). Structural validation per 01-skill-isa.md: the compositional algebra (sequence / parallel / reactive / repeat / branch / let-bind), that every primitive call key is one of the 50 ISA primitive ids, and that an extension call is namespaced ext.<ns>.<name>. Per-primitive parameter names, types, units, and enums are constrained only for primitives precisely typed so far (approach B, tightened one primitive at a time — currently all of category 1 reach except reach.retract (reach.to_pose § 1.1, reach.approach § 1.2, reach.align § 1.3, reach.hover § 1.5, reach.scan § 1.6), all of category 2 grasp (grasp.pinch § 2.1, grasp.power § 2.2, grasp.hook § 2.3, grasp.precision_tripod § 2.4, grasp.lateral § 2.5, grasp.platform § 2.6, grasp.pin § 2.7, grasp.envelope § 2.8, grasp.adjust § 2.9, grasp.release § 2.10), all of category 3 in_hand (in_hand.rotate § 3.1, in_hand.translate § 3.2, in_hand.regrasp § 3.3, in_hand.roll § 3.4, in_hand.pivot § 3.5, in_hand.slide § 3.6, in_hand.flip § 3.7), transport.move_to_pose § 4.1, and all of category 7 sense (sense.probe § 7.1, sense.inspect § 7.2, sense.weigh § 7.3, sense.locate § 7.4, sense.verify § 7.5); every other primitive's params is an open object. Backs conformance test class 1 (parser conformance, 05-conformance.md). The algebra is the abstract BNF of 01 § Compositional algebra; this schema fixes its concrete YAML serialization, where a let-bind is a sequence statement {let, from} whose binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence (the BNF's explicit in(...) is accepted as an optional key).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the skill does.

body.description: The skill body: a single Composition (typically a sequence).

ObjectMap.description: Task object references, keyed by local name. Each entry names an ObjectRef whose pose is resolved at runtime by a sense.* primitive (01 § Object reference).

ref.description: The object identity (ObjectRef) this local name binds to.

PrimitiveId.description: The 50 Skill ISA primitive ids, category.primitive in lowercase snake_case (01 § Provisional primitive enumeration). The enumeration is closed; extension primitives use the ext.<ns>.<name> form instead.

Params.description: A primitive's parameter block. Structurally an open object (or absent / null for a param-less call). This is the open floor that applies to every primitive; for primitives precisely typed so far it is intersected with a per-primitive schema via the allOf clauses of PrimitiveCall, so the precise schema is what binds for those keys.

Ref.description: A reference to a let-bound value (BNF Reference / Identifier): a bare identifier, optionally &-prefixed, naming a value bound earlier by a let-bind. In the serialized form any typed parameter may instead be such a reference (e.g. target: connector_t). The BNF's reserved terminals (auto, active, until, all, until_satisfied) are excluded so they are accepted only where a parameter's own schema lists them (Auto / GraspHandle / HoldDuration / Axes / Count); this keeps e.g. hold_duration: auto from sneaking in as a reference.

Axis.description: An unsigned principal axis of a frame (01 § Geometric types): x, y, or z. Distinct from SignedAxis (a +/- axis).

Auto.description: Defer the value to the Translation Layer's planner (BNF Auto). Accepted only where the spec types a parameter as T | auto.

Force.description: A force value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit N): a unit-suffixed quantity string (N / kN / mN) or a let-reference.

Duration.description: A duration value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit s): a unit-suffixed quantity string (s / ms), a let-reference, or auto.

Length.description: A length value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit m, parameter tables may author in mm): a unit-suffixed quantity string (m / mm / cm) or a let-reference.

Ratio.description: A dimensionless ratio (01 § Dimensioned scalars), [0,1) unless stated: a number in that range or a let-reference.

HoldDuration.description: A hold duration (01 § reach.hover / force.push): a duration quantity (s / ms), the literal until (defer to an enclosing reactive), or a let-reference. Unlike Duration this does NOT accept auto.

Angle.description: An angle value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit rad, parameter tables may author in deg): a unit-suffixed quantity string (deg / rad) or a let-reference.

Velocity.description: A linear-velocity value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit m/s): a unit-suffixed quantity string (m/s) or a let-reference.

Acceleration.description: A linear-acceleration value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit m/s^2): a unit-suffixed quantity string (m/s^2 or m/s²) or a let-reference.

AngularVelocity.description: An angular-velocity value (01 § Dimensioned scalars; canonical wire unit rad/s): a unit-suffixed quantity string (rad/s) or a let-reference.

FrameRef.description: A reference to a calibrated frame on the kinematic tree or in the world (01 § Geometric types). A frame name (e.g. task, receptacle, tcp_thumb).

SignedAxis.description: A signed principal axis of a frame (01 § Geometric types), e.g. -z. Symbolic tool-axis spellings (e.g. -tool_axis) are NOT this type and are not yet covered.

GraspHandle.description: A handle to an established grasp (01 § GraspRef): the literal active (the current grasp on the controlled frame) or a let-reference to a grasp bound earlier.

ContactResponse.description: Reaction to unplanned contact, shared across reach / transport primitives.

Compliance.description: Compliance mode requested for a contact-forming primitive (01 § force / sense.probe).

Direction.description: A unit vector in a named frame (01 § Geometric types), or a let-reference. Inline object (the vector / its components) or a reference; the planner literal auto is accepted only where a parameter's own schema lists it.

Compound.description: A perception-derived compound value (01 § Target / reference types — ObjectTarget, FeatureRef, SurfaceTarget, Pose6D, TactileTarget, ContactConfig). RFL fixes the type but not the estimation method; here it is supplied inline as an object or by a let-reference (typically a sense.* result). Internal field typing is a deeper increment.

CompoundOrAuto.description: A perception-derived compound (see Compound) typed T | auto in the spec: the literal auto (planner-derived), an inline object, or a let-reference.

SlipResponse.description: Reaction to detected slip, shared across grasp primitives (default retighten).

RegripPolicy.description: How the embodiment effects an in-hand reorientation / translation — finger gaiting vs continuous (01 § in_hand.rotate / translate); a hint resolved by the Translation Layer (default auto).

Axes.description: A set of principal axes, or all (01 § reach.align). Either the literal all or a non-empty array drawn from {x, y, z}.

GraspPinchParams.description: Parameters of grasp.pinch (01 § 2.1), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 2.1 table, no more. target + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. Any value may be a let-reference; auto is accepted only where the spec types the parameter as T | auto. The internal field typing of ObjectTarget / Pose6D / TactileTarget is a deeper increment — here each is an inline object or a reference.

target.description: ObjectTarget to pinch-grasp (perception-derived; typically reaches the call as a let-reference). An inline object or a let-reference.

force_budget.description: Max grip force, > 0; clamped to embodiment.limits.grip_force_max and target.max_contact_force if declared.

grasp_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — pinch contact-frame pose; auto = planner-derived from target geometry.

grasp_width.description: Length | auto — pre-close opening; auto = from target geometry.

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — contact-confirmation criterion in TactileManifold terms; auto = normal_force >= epsilon at >= 2 antipodal sites.

SenseLocateParams.description: Parameters of sense.locate (01 § 7.4), precisely typed (approach B). target_ref is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. auto is accepted only where the spec types the parameter as T | auto; Region internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

target_ref.description: ObjectRef | FeatureRef — the object identity / feature whose pose is estimated.

modality.description: Sensing modality (default auto = best available for the required precision).

required_precision.description: Length | auto — pose precision the result must achieve (default embodiment default).

search_region.description: Region | auto — where to look (default the expected vicinity).

frame.description: FrameRef — reference frame for the returned pose (default task).

TransportMoveToPoseParams.description: Parameters of transport.move_to_pose (01 § 4.1), precisely typed (approach B). target_pose is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. Pose6D internals are a deeper increment — here target_pose is an inline object or a reference.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the grasp whose held object is transported.

target_pose.description: Pose6D — pose of the held object (not the effector) in frame. Inline object or let-reference.

max_acceleration.description: Acceleration | auto — clamped to the grasp's dynamic-stability limit.

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — margin for the swept volume of object + effector.

contact_response.description: Reaction to unplanned contact of object or effector (default abort).

ReachAlignParams.description: Parameters of reach.align (01 § 1.3), precisely typed (approach B). target_frame is required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

axes.description: set<{x,y,z}> | all (default all) — controlled-frame axes to bring parallel to target_frame.

hold_position.description: Keep controlled_frame position fixed during rotation (default true).

position_tolerance.description: Length > 0 — drift bound while rotating (default 2 mm).

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — margin to the static model over the swept volume.

GraspReleaseParams.description: Parameters of grasp.release (01 § 2.10), precisely typed (approach B). All parameters are optional (grasp_handle defaults to active), so a param-less call (null / empty) is valid.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the grasp to release.

withdraw_axis.description: SignedAxis — direction to withdraw after opening (default -embodiment.default_tool_axis).

clearance_distance.description: Length | auto — distance to withdraw clear of the object envelope.

allow_drop.description: Permit release when the object is not stably supported (default false).

confirm_release.description: Verify no residual contact after opening (default true).

ReachToPoseParams.description: Parameters of reach.to_pose (01 § 1.1), precisely typed (approach B) — the nine parameters of the § 1.1 table, no more. target_pose is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. There is no acceleration parameter (unlike transport.move_to_pose). Pose6D internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

target_pose.description: Pose6D — goal pose of the controlled frame in frame; must admit >= 1 IK solution. Inline object or let-reference.

controlled_frame.description: FrameRef — a declared control frame (default embodiment.default_control_frame).

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — minimum margin to the static collision model.

ReachApproachParams.description: Parameters of reach.approach (01 § 1.2), precisely typed (approach B) — the ten parameters of the § 1.2 table, no more. target + standoff are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. approach_axis is an Axis (unsigned). SurfaceTarget internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

target.description: SurfaceTarget — resolvable point + outward unit normal in a calibrated frame. Inline object or let-reference.

standoff.description: Length > 0 — terminal distance from the surface along the normal.

approach_axis.description: Axis — controlled-frame axis aligned anti-parallel to the normal (default embodiment.default_tool_axis).

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — margin to the static model, excluding target.

contact_response.description: Reaction to contact before standoff (default abort).

ReachHoverParams.description: Parameters of reach.hover (01 § 1.5), precisely typed (approach B) — the twelve parameters of the § 1.5 table, no more. target + standoff are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. There is no timeout parameter (the hold is bounded by duration / the enclosing reactive). duration is Duration | until, not Duration | auto. target is a SurfaceTarget | FrameRef.

target.description: SurfaceTarget | FrameRef — reference to hover over; may be time-varying. Inline object or let-reference (a bare FrameRef name is also a reference).

standoff.description: Length > 0 — maintained distance from target along the normal.

approach_axis.description: Axis — axis held anti-parallel to the normal (default embodiment.default_tool_axis).

station_tolerance.description: Length — allowed positional excursion from the hover setpoint (default 2 mm).

duration.description: Duration | until (default until = defer termination to an enclosing reactive).

track_target.description: Follow a moving target vs. hold a fixed setpoint (default false).

settling_time.description: Duration | auto — max time to return within station_tolerance after a disturbance.

max_velocity.description: Velocity | auto — correction / tracking speed cap.

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — margin to the static model, excluding target.

ReachScanParams.description: Parameters of reach.scan (01 § 1.6), precisely typed (approach B) — the thirteen parameters of the § 1.6 table, no more. region + standoff are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. The sweep pattern parameter is named pattern (enum raster / spiral / arc / waypoints, default raster) and the region parameter is named region. coverage_overlap is Ratio | auto. ScanRegion internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

region.description: ScanRegion — volume / surface / path to cover, in a calibrated frame. Inline object or let-reference.

sensor_frame.description: FrameRef — frame whose coverage matters (default embodiment.default_sensor_frame).

standoff.description: Length > 0 — sensor-to-region distance maintained during the sweep.

pattern.description: Deterministic sweep pattern over the region (default raster).

coverage_overlap.description: Ratio | auto — overlap between passes (default auto, derived from the sensor FOV).

sensor_axis.description: Axis — sensor axis pointed at the region (default the sensor descriptor bore_axis).

dwell.description: Duration (default 0) — hold time at each sweep pose for sensor integration.

max_velocity.description: Velocity | auto — sweep speed; also bounded by the sensor max_sweep_rate.

clearance.description: Length >= 0 (default 0) — margin to the static model over the sweep, excluding region.

SenseProbeParams.description: Parameters of sense.probe (01 § 7.1), precisely typed (approach B) — the nine parameters of the § 7.1 table, no more. target_pose + contact_force are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. contact_force is the light force at which contact is REGISTERED (a measurement threshold, not actuation). Pose6D internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

controlled_frame.description: FrameRef — the probing frame, fingertip / probe tip (default embodiment.default_tactile_frame).

target_pose.description: Pose6D — where to probe, in frame. Inline object or let-reference.

probe_direction.description: Direction | auto — approach direction to contact (default auto = expected surface normal).

contact_force.description: Force — the light force at which contact is registered (measurement, not actuation).

max_probe_force.description: Force | auto — hard cap guaranteeing non-disturbance (default auto = below the target's disturb threshold).

measure.description: set<{presence, location, normal, stiffness}> — what to measure on contact (default {presence, location}).

compliance.description: Compliance for a gentle, non-disturbing touch (default auto).

SenseInspectParams.description: Parameters of sense.inspect (01 § 7.2), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 7.2 table, no more. target is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. observe selects what to capture (interpretation is out of RFL scope). target (ObjectTarget | SurfaceTarget | FrameRef) and observation_pose (Pose6D | auto) internals are deferred (inline object or reference).

sensor_frame.description: FrameRef — the observing sensor frame (default embodiment.default_sensor_frame).

target.description: ObjectTarget | SurfaceTarget | FrameRef — what to observe. Inline object or let-reference.

observe.description: set<{presence, pose, appearance, defect, custom}> — what to capture (default {presence, pose}); interpretation is out of RFL scope.

observation_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — sensor pose for the observation (default auto = target in FOV, unoccluded, at working distance).

standoff.description: Length | auto — sensor-to-target distance (default auto = sensor working range).

SenseWeighParams.description: Parameters of sense.weigh (01 § 7.3), precisely typed (approach B) — the seven parameters of the § 7.3 table, no more. All parameters are optional (grasp_handle defaults to active), so a param-less call (null / empty) is valid. measure selects mass and/or center_of_mass (CoM needs multiple poses).

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the grasp holding the object to weigh.

method.description: static = support against gravity (F = mg); dynamic = known acceleration (F = ma) (default auto).

measure.description: set<{mass, center_of_mass}> — what to estimate (default {mass}); CoM needs multiple poses.

up_direction.description: Direction — gravity reference for the static method, declared not assumed (default -gravity).

settle_time.description: Duration | auto — time to let force readings settle before sampling.

SenseVerifyParams.description: Parameters of sense.verify (01 § 7.5), precisely typed (approach B) — the five parameters of the § 7.5 table, no more. predicate is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. predicate is a StatePredicate, unified with the algebra Predicate (a let-reference to a hoisted predicate is also accepted). evidence_modalities is set<{visual, tactile, force, proprioceptive}> | auto. confidence_threshold is Ratio | auto.

predicate.description: StatePredicate — the condition to check (a Predicate, § algebra), or a let-reference to one.

evidence_modalities.description: set<{visual, tactile, force, proprioceptive}> | auto — which observations to use (default auto = those sufficient for the predicate).

confidence_threshold.description: Ratio | auto — min confidence to assert true / false rather than indeterminate.

GraspPowerParams.description: Parameters of grasp.power (01 § 2.2), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 2.2 table, no more. target + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

force_budget.description: Force > 0; clamped to embodiment.limits.grip_force_max and target.max_contact_force.

grasp_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — enclosure contact-frame pose (default auto).

enclosure_completeness.description: Ratio | auto — required fraction of available contact sites that must engage (default auto).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — desired enclosure contact state (default auto).

GraspHookParams.description: Parameters of grasp.hook (01 § 2.3), precisely typed (approach B) — the nine parameters of the § 2.3 table, no more. target + load_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. load_budget (not force_budget) is the load the engagement must support — there is no opposing squeeze.

target.description: ObjectTarget — must expose a hookable feature.

hook_feature.description: FeatureRef | auto — the handle / loop / bar to engage (default auto).

load_budget.description: Force > 0 — load the engagement must support (replaces force_budget; no opposing squeeze).

load_direction.description: Direction | auto — primary supported load direction (default auto = anticipated load, often gravity).

seating_force.description: Force | auto — small force to fully seat the hook; bounded by target.max_contact_force.

grasp_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — hook engagement pose (default auto).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — contact along the hook inner curve / full seating (default auto).

GraspPrecisionTripodParams.description: Parameters of grasp.precision_tripod (01 § 2.4), precisely typed (approach B) — the seven parameters of the § 2.4 table, no more. target + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

target.description: ObjectTarget — small object for three-finger opposition.

force_budget.description: Force > 0; clamped to grip_force_max and target.max_contact_force.

grasp_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — tripod contact-frame pose (default auto).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — auto = normal_force >= epsilon at 3 non-collinear sites (default auto).

GraspLateralParams.description: Parameters of grasp.lateral (01 § 2.5), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 2.5 table, no more. target + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

target.description: ObjectTarget — thin / flat object for a side (key-grip) grasp.

grasp_edge.description: FeatureRef | auto — the edge to grip against the thumb side (default auto).

grasp_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — lateral contact-frame pose (default auto).

GraspPlatformParams.description: Parameters of grasp.platform (01 § 2.6), precisely typed (approach B) — the seven parameters of the § 2.6 table, no more. target + load_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. The force parameter is load_budget (max supported weight), not force_budget — this is an open-palm support, not a closing grasp.

target.description: ObjectTarget — must carry a center-of-mass estimate.

load_budget.description: Force > 0 — max supported weight; clamped to embodiment.limits.payload_support.

support_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — pose of the support surface under the object (default auto = center CoM).

support_normal.description: Direction | auto — direction the support resists, usually anti-gravity (default auto = opposing the load).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — auto = distributed load over the support area with CoM inside the polygon (default auto).

GraspPinParams.description: Parameters of grasp.pin (01 § 2.7), precisely typed (approach B) — the seven parameters of the § 2.7 table, no more. target + against_surface + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. There is no slip_response.

target.description: ObjectTarget — object to pin against an opposing surface.

against_surface.description: SurfaceTarget — the surface to pin the object against.

force_budget.description: Force > 0 — normal force pressing the object onto the surface; clamped to grip_force_max and target.max_contact_force.

pin_pose.description: Pose6D | auto — effector contact pose on the object's exposed face (default auto = opposite against_surface).

GraspEnvelopeParams.description: Parameters of grasp.envelope (01 § 2.8), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 2.8 table, no more. target + force_budget are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

target.description: ObjectTarget — object / soft body to enclose.

force_budget.description: Force > 0 — gentle; clamped to limits + fragility.

mode.description: conform to the object, or cage it with clearance (default conform).

cage_clearance.description: Length | auto — (cage) gap to leave around the object (default auto).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — desired enclosure contact state (default auto).

GraspAdjustParams.description: Parameters of grasp.adjust (01 § 2.9), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 2.9 table, no more. All parameters are optional (grasp_handle defaults to active), so a param-less call (null / empty) is valid.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp to modify.

new_force_budget.description: Force | auto — adjusted grip force (default auto = re-derive from feedback).

recenter.description: Re-center contacts on the object (default false).

preserve_pose.description: Keep object pose fixed during the adjustment (default true).

position_tolerance.description: Length — allowed object pose drift during adjust (default 2 mm).

tactile_target.description: TactileTarget | auto — target contact state after adjustment (default auto).

InHandRotateParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.rotate (01 § 3.1), precisely typed (approach B) — the ten parameters of the § 3.1 table, no more. axis + angle are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. in_hand has no slip_response.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp to manipulate within.

axis.description: Direction — rotation axis, in the grasp frame.

orientation_tolerance.description: Angle > 0, geodesic on the achieved reorientation (default 2 deg).

keep_position.description: Hold the object's in-grasp position fixed (rotate, not translate) (default true).

position_tolerance.description: Length — drift bound while rotating, when keep_position (default 2 mm).

InHandTranslateParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.translate (01 § 3.2), precisely typed (approach B) — the ten parameters of the § 3.2 table, no more. direction + distance are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp to manipulate within.

direction.description: Direction — translation direction, in the grasp frame.

position_tolerance.description: Length > 0 — on the achieved displacement (default 2 mm).

keep_orientation.description: Hold the object's in-grasp orientation fixed (translate, not rotate) (default true).

orientation_tolerance.description: Angle — drift bound while translating, when keep_orientation (default 2 deg).

InHandRegraspParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.regrasp (01 § 3.3), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 3.3 table, no more. target_mode is required; the rest carry the spec defaults. target_mode (GraspMode) and target_contacts (ContactConfig | auto) internals are deferred.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the current grasp to transition from.

target_mode.description: GraspMode — the grasp mode to transition to (may equal current with different contacts).

target_contacts.description: ContactConfig | auto — desired new contact configuration (default auto = planner-derived for target_mode).

target_force_budget.description: Force | auto — force budget of the new grasp (default auto = re-derive).

preserve_pose.description: Keep the object's world pose fixed during the handover (default true).

position_tolerance.description: Length — object pose drift bound during handover (default 2 mm).

InHandRollParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.roll (01 § 3.4), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 3.4 table, no more. roll_axis + angle are required; the rest carry the spec defaults.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp to roll within.

roll_axis.description: Direction — rolling axis, in the grasp frame (the object's rolling axis).

angle.description: Angle — signed roll magnitude (may exceed 2pi for continuous rolling).

keep_contact_line.description: Keep the object's rolling axis stationary in the grasp frame (default true).

InHandPivotParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.pivot (01 § 3.5), precisely typed (approach B) — the nine parameters of the § 3.5 table, no more. pivot_axis + angle are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. pivot_point is FeatureRef | auto.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp providing the pivot contact.

pivot_point.description: FeatureRef | auto — the contact point to pivot about (default auto = current securing contact).

pivot_axis.description: Direction — axis of the pivot rotation, in the grasp frame.

angle.description: Angle — target swing angle about pivot_axis.

orientation_tolerance.description: Angle > 0, looser default for passively-driven pivots (default 5 deg).

max_angular_velocity.description: AngularVelocity | auto — bounds the swing rate (esp. for gravity drive).

InHandSlideParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.slide (01 § 3.6), precisely typed (approach B) — the eight parameters of the § 3.6 table, no more. slide_direction + stop_condition are required; the rest carry the spec defaults. There is no slip_response (the slide is a controlled slip). stop_condition is a SlideStop (StopCondition family); its internals are deferred to an inline object or a let-reference (precise StopCondition typing is gated on the 01 § 6 formatting pass).

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the established grasp to slide within.

slide_direction.description: Direction — direction of slip along the contact surface, in the grasp frame.

stop_condition.description: SlideStop — what ends the slide: distance(d) | tactile_landmark(ref) | external_reference(ref). Inline object or let-reference.

drive.description: Active feed vs gravity-fed slip (default actuated).

position_tolerance.description: Length > 0, looser default (slip is friction-dependent) (default 3 mm).

max_velocity.description: Velocity | auto — bounds slip rate (esp. for gravity feed).

InHandFlipParams.description: Parameters of in_hand.flip (01 § 3.7), precisely typed (approach B) — the nine parameters of the § 3.7 table, no more. flip_axis + angle + max_release_time + safe_drop_zone are required (flip is the only continuity-suspending primitive; the safe-drop zone is mandatory). target_mode is GraspMode | same. catch_envelope / safe_drop_zone (Region) internals are deferred.

grasp_handle.description: GraspRef | active (default active) — the current grasp to flip from.

flip_axis.description: Direction — reorientation axis, in the grasp frame.

angle.description: Angle — reorientation magnitude (the angle unreachable without release).

target_mode.description: GraspMode | same — grasp mode to re-establish after the flip (default same).

catch_envelope.description: Region | auto — region within which the re-catch must occur (default auto = planner-derived).

max_release_time.description: Duration > 0 — hard upper bound on the unsecured window.

safe_drop_zone.description: Region — region below the operation where an uncaught object lands without harm (mandatory).

Composition.description: A node of the compositional algebra (01 § Compositional algebra). Exactly one of: a primitive call, an extension call, or one of the combinators sequence / parallel / reactive / repeat / branch / let-bind. The forms are disjoint by key namespace, so a well-formed node matches exactly one.

PrimitiveCall.description: A core primitive invocation: a single key that is a PrimitiveId, mapping to its params (BNF Primitive ::= PrimitiveId "(" ParamList? ")"). Most primitives' params are an open object (#/$defs/Params); primitives precisely typed so far (approach B) additionally constrain their params via the conditional clauses in allOf. The open floor and the matching typed clause both apply to the same key, so the typed schema is what binds for those primitives; one if/then clause is added per primitive as the typing proceeds.

ExtensionCall.description: An extension primitive invocation (BNF Extension ::= "ext" "." Identifier "." Identifier ...). The id is ext.<namespace>.<name>; the registry (06-extension-registry.md) owns the namespace, not this schema.

Sequence.description: Ordered composition: each child runs to completion before the next (BNF Sequence). A let-bind child binds a name visible to the children that follow it in the same sequence.

Parallel.description: Concurrent composition of two or more branches (BNF Parallel).

Reactive.description: Run a body until a predicate confirms true (BNF Reactive ::= "reactive" "(" Composition "," "until" "(" Predicate ")" ")"). Per 01 § three-valued control flow the body terminates only on a confident true; a concurrent envelope violation takes precedence over a clean until completion.

Repeat.description: Repeat a body a fixed count or until satisfied (BNF Repeat ::= "repeat" "(" Composition "," Count ")", Count ::= Integer | "until_satisfied").

Branch.description: Three-valued conditional (BNF Branch). then / else are taken on a confident true / false; the optional unknown arm is taken on indeterminate, and without it an indeterminate predicate escalates rather than guessing (01 § three-valued control flow).

LetBind.description: Hoist a planner-derived value (typically a sense.* result) for reuse (BNF LetBind ::= "let" "(" Identifier ":=" Expression ")" "in" "(" Composition ")"). Concrete YAML form: a {let, from} statement whose binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence; the BNF's explicit in(...) is accepted as the optional in key. Downstream uncertainty / measured-value flow checks are owned by 01 § LetBind flow checks, not this schema.

let.description: The bound identifier; later primitives reference its value by name.

from.description: The expression whose result is bound (typically a sense.* primitive call).

in.description: Optional explicit scope (BNF in(...)); omitted when the binding scopes over the rest of the enclosing sequence.

Predicate.description: A predicate of the algebra (BNF Predicate), consumed by reactive (until) and branch. A single key naming the predicate kind, mapping to its (here unconstrained) argument. value / confidence / evidence verdict semantics are owned by 01 § Predicates, verdicts, and three-valued control flow.
